title: The Summer of Owen Todd
author: Tony Abbott
current_text: The Summer of Owen Todd was removed at the district level from August 10, 2023, to March 8, 2024; its status was listed as pending. The Summer of Owen Todd was listed among books banned in Escambia County, Florida.
